claims.evidence: Witness only reports PS4/DUALSHOCK 4 controller boxes and a black PS4 console box watermark; no CUH model/version or storage details were read.
No console power-on, menu screen, storage contents, or game list was shown.

claims.claim: comes with two brand new pads
claims.evidence: Witness sees two DualShock 4 controller boxes, but does not confirm the actual controllers are included or that they are brand new/unused.

risks.risk: Controllers may not be included, or may be used/defective (stick drift, unresponsive buttons).
risks.proof: A clear video showing both controllers in-hand with all buttons tested and thumbsticks moving smoothly (no drift), plus close-ups of ports and serial labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not guaranteed working/condition unknown.

risks.risk: Authenticity risk: boxes may be genuine while controllers/console may be counterfeit or parts-swapped.
risks.proof: Photos of controller serial numbers/labels and console CUH label (model/version) matching the device, plus a boot screen showing system info.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as potentially non-authentic/parts-mixed.

risks.risk: Console may not be included or may be non-functional (won’t power on, faulty HDMI/power supply).
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on to the home screen, showing storage/system settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / not working.

risks.risk: Storage size and console version (PS4 Slim CUH) unknown; affects value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console label (CUH number) and a screenshot/photo of storage capacity in settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for lower-spec/unknown version.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (power cable, HDMI cable, headset jack cover, manuals).
risks.proof: Lay-out photo of every included accessory with a checklist (power, HDMI, cables, manuals, controller charging cable if any).

risks.risk: “Hacked with games installed” may be false or may involve account/bans; also games may not be transferable.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the console showing installed games list and system status, plus confirmation of whether it’s offline/online and any account details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard console with no guaranteed games.

proof_requests: Power-on video to the PS4 home screen showing system info (CUH model/version and storage).
Close-up photos of the console label (CUH number) and controller serial labels.
Video showing both controllers connected and a full button + stick test (no drift, responsive buttons).
Photo/video of the full accessory set laid out (power cable, HDMI, controllers, manuals, any other included items).
Screenshot/photo of the installed games list (or game library) on the console.
response.reason: The witness confirms PS4/DUALSHOCK 4 packaging, but key value drivers (console model/version, whether controllers are included and working, authenticity, accessories, and whether games are actually installed) are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
